unitTitle: Ask, answer and follow up at work or school
title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 8: Ask, answer and follow up at work or school

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Track which person owns each task and which document the pronouns replace. If you lose the reference, ask a short clarification question before continuing.

steps.title: Prepare the meeting report
steps.body: Sam and Lina coordinate a project meeting at a training centre.

examples.fr: Le compte rendu, tu le relis avant midi ?
examples.en: Lina: The meeting report, can you proofread it before noon?

examples.fr: Oui, je le relis après le cours.
examples.en: Sam: Yes, I will proofread it after class.

examples.fr: Je la corrige avec le tuteur de stage.
examples.en: Sam: I am correcting it with the internship supervisor.

examples.fr: Les fichiers du projet sont dans le dossier partagé.
examples.en: Lina: The project files are in the shared folder.

examples.fr: Je vais les classer par date et enregistrer la version finale.
examples.en: Sam: I am going to file them by date and save the final version.

examples.fr: Tu peux envoyer le compte rendu au groupe ?
examples.en: Lina: Can you send the report to the group?

examples.fr: Oui, je vais l'envoyer avant la réunion.
examples.en: Sam: Yes, I am going to send it before the meeting.

steps.title: Clarify the assignment
steps.body: Nadia asks a classmate which item the instructor needs first.

examples.fr: La formatrice demande le plan de présentation et la liste de corrections.
examples.en: Nadia: The instructor asks for the presentation outline and list of corrections.
Karim: Are you going to prepare them today?

examples.fr: Je vais préparer le plan, mais la liste est prête.
examples.en: Nadia: I am going to prepare the outline, but the list is ready.

examples.fr: Tu la remets avec le brouillon ?
examples.en: Karim: Are you handing it in with the draft?

examples.fr: Oui, je la joins au dossier de projet.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes, I am attaching it to the project file.

examples.fr: Et le brouillon, tu l'envoies aussi ?
examples.en: Karim: And the draft, are you sending it too?

examples.fr: Oui. Je vais l'envoyer après avoir relu les corrections.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes. I am going to send it after rereading the corrections.

steps.prompt: When will Sam proofread the report?
steps.explain: Sam says he will reread it after class.

steps.prompt: What will Sam do with the project files?
steps.explain: He says he will classify them by date.

steps.prompt: Which items does the instructor request?
options: The audio file and rent notice
steps.explain: Nadia names the outline and list of corrections.

steps.prompt: What does Nadia attach to the project file?
steps.explain: She says she attaches the list to the project file.
